summary: Iteration 26 - Dashboard RBAC Bug Fix Verification: Both bugs FIXED and verified. Bug #1 (Dashboard cards showing 0 for director) fixed via broad_access_roles update in resolve_hierarchy_filter. Bug #2 (SSO MSAL role persistence) fix verified via code review. Backend: 12/12 tests passed. Frontend: Admin and Director dashboards verified with non-zero values.
critical_code_review_comments: card_builder.py Line 49-50: broad_access_roles now correctly includes product_director and sales_director
card_builder.py Line 62: admin_patterns now includes 'all documents' and 'crm / sales director' for RBAC group matching
microsoft_auth/routes.py Line 665-679: _handle_msal_complete now correctly derives and persists roles/permissions for existing users with empty roles
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 26 verified two critical bug fixes: (1) Dashboard RBAC filter - product_director/sales_director now have broad access via resolve_hierarchy_filter, (2) SSO MSAL flow now persists roles/permissions to DB. Key endpoints tested: /api/auth/login, /api/auth/me, /api/odoo-rbac/current-user-rbac, /api/card-builder/my-dashboard?year=2026. Director user (vimod.c@securado.net) now sees full dashboard data including invoice cards.

bug_1_dashboard_zeros_for_director.description: Dashboard cards were showing 0 for director role
bug_1_dashboard_zeros_for_director.root_cause: resolve_hierarchy_filter in card_builder.py did not include product_director/sales_director in broad_access_roles

bug_2_sso_msal_role_persistence.description: SSO MSAL flow was not persisting roles/permissions to DB for existing users
bug_2_sso_msal_role_persistence.root_cause: _handle_msal_complete was not deriving roles from RBAC for existing users with empty roles
bug_2_sso_msal_role_persistence.note: Cannot test end-to-end SSO in preview environment, but code logic verified
